description: This file defines the NodeViewBuilder class for rendering node entities in Drupal, including methods for building component arrays, rendering links, and handling cache behavior.

classes.name: NodeViewBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for building the render arrays for node entities, including links and language information, with support for cache management and lazy loading of links.

methods.name: buildComponents
methods.description: Builds the render components for node entities, adding links and language info based on display configuration.

methods.name: getBuildDefaults
methods.description: Provides default build settings for a node, excluding cache when in preview mode.

methods.name: renderLinks
methods.description: Static method that builds the links (e.g., 'Read more') for a node, used as a lazy builder callback.

methods.name: buildLinks
methods.description: Constructs the default set of links for a node, especially the 'Read more' link in teaser view mode.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns an array of callback method names that are trusted for lazy evaluation.
